title: Culturing C. elegans Worms in Liquid Culture
author: Cristian Riccio
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5v9g696
materials: Aspirate most of the liquid from the flask.

steps.title: Prepare S Basal stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5.85 g NaCl, 1 g K₂HPO₄, 6 g KH₂PO₄ and add 1 mL cholesterol solution (5 mg/mL in ethanol) in distilled water and bring the volume to 1 L; autoclave to sterilize.

steps.title: Prepare potassium citrate stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 20 g citric acid monohydrate and 293.5 g tri‑potassium citrate monohydrate in distilled water and bring to 1 L; adjust to pH 6.0 if needed; autoclave to sterilize.

steps.title: Prepare trace metals stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.86 g disodium EDTA, 0.69 g FeSO₄·7H₂O, 0.20 g MnCl₂·4H₂O, 0.29 g ZnSO₄·7H₂O and 0.025 g CuSO₄·5H₂O in distilled water and bring to 1 L; autoclave, then store the solution in the dark.

steps.title: Prepare calcium chloride stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 55.5 g CaCl₂ in distilled water and bring to 1 L; autoclave to sterilize.

steps.title: Assemble S Medium
steps.instruction: In a sterile container combine 1 L S Basal, 10 mL 1 M potassium citrate (pH 6.0), 10 mL trace metals solution, 3 mL 1 M CaCl₂ and 3 mL 1 M MgSO₄; mix using sterile technique and do NOT autoclave.

steps.title: Sterilize culture flask
steps.instruction: Obtain a sterilized 1–2 L glass or plastic flask; keep it sterile until use.

steps.title: Add S Medium to flask
steps.instruction: Add 250 mL of the prepared S Medium to the sterilized flask.

steps.title: Inoculate with E. coli OP50
steps.instruction: Add a concentrated E. coli OP50 pellet that was prepared from 2–3 L of an overnight OP50 culture to the 250 mL S Medium in the flask.

steps.title: Wash and add cleared plates
steps.instruction: For each of four large C. elegans plates that have been cleared of bacteria, wash the plate with 5 mL S Medium and transfer the wash (containing the worms) into the flask.

steps.title: Add arrested L1 worms
steps.instruction: Introduce the desired number of arrested L1 worms directly into the liquid culture (optional step to minimise contamination and synchronise growth).

steps.title: Incubate with shaking
steps.instruction: Place the flask on a shaker set to 20 °C and shake vigorously to ensure good oxygenation.

steps.title: Monitor culture and feed
steps.instruction: Periodically check a drop of the culture under a microscope; when the solution is no longer visibly cloudy (food depleted), add more concentrated OP50 suspended in S Medium. Continue monitoring until many adult worms are visible in each drop (typically day 4–5).

steps.title: Harvest culture
steps.instruction: When the culture is ready (many adults present, usually on the 4th or 5th day), proceed to harvest the worms.

steps.title: Settle worms on ice
steps.instruction: Place the flask on ice for 15 minutes to allow the worms to settle to the bottom.

steps.title: Centrifuge worm suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer the remaining liquid to a sterile 50 mL conical centrifuge tube and spin for at least 2 minutes at 1150 × g. Note: young larvae may require longer than 2 minutes to pellet.

steps.title: Aspirate supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate the supernatant, leaving the worm pellet (which may contain adults, larvae and eggs) for downstream use.
